title: Mid Market Account Executive
description:
GSD Search has been engaged to identify an AE for a local technology company looking to add to their AE team. Please take a look and apply OR share with your network!

Job Title: Mid-Market Account Executive (West Coast)

Job Type: Full-Time (Salary 100k , 100k Variable -- 200k OTE)
Location: California (Remote with travel)

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Account Executive to drive revenue growth by identifying, consulting, and closing managed services for healthcare organizations. This individual will manage both existing accounts and pursue new business opportunities within the mid-market healthcare space—specifically targeting hospitals under 300 beds and organizations with annual revenue below $500 million.

Key Responsibilities

  • Actively prospect daily using multiple tools and techniques including LinkedIn, networking events, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain a strong professional network within the healthcare technology and cybersecurity markets.

  • Identify, evaluate, and pursue prospective clients through cold calling, email campaigns, social media, conference attendance, and other outreach strategies.

  • Engage with decision-makers across healthcare providers, life sciences, and other HIPAA-regulated organizations.

  • Develop strong relationships with key stakeholders, including executives, to understand business needs and propose appropriate solutions.

  • Lead the full sales cycle from prospecting to close, collaborating with internal teams such as Channel Sales, Solutions Architects, Operations, and RevOps to ensure seamless deal execution.

  • Manage RFP responses, contractual documentation, and pricing proposals in coordination with the internal operations team.

  • Consistently meet or exceed established sales goals, metrics, and quotas.

  • Maintain accurate records of pipeline activity, forecasts, and deal progression using Salesforce and other sales automation tools.

  • Develop territory management strategies to ensure consistent growth and revenue achievement.

Qualifications

Education & Experience:

  • 3–5+ years of B2B sales experience required; healthcare cybersecurity or IT services experience preferred.

  • Proven success selling through channel partners and directly to end users.

  • Demonstrated ability to engage with C-suite executives (CIO, CISO) and senior decision-makers within healthcare organizations.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong understanding of sales best practices and consultative selling.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

  • Working knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA), and healthcare IT environments.

  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple priorities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce CRM.

Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel as needed to meet with clients and attend industry events.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

GSD Search provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws

title: Pharmacy Technician
description:
GSD Search has an immediate need for a remote Pharmacy Tech! This is a contract that is needing to start ASAP! It is a shorter project likely finishing end of year. 

Job Summary:

  • Outbound patient calls: Contact patients to remind them of upcoming prescription refills and address any adherence issues.
  • Identify and resolve barriers: Investigate and problem-solve medication access issues, such as financial hardship, insurance claims, or pharmacy claims, including prior authorizations.
  • Patient support and coordination: Help patients understand their medication regimens and side effects, and coordinate prescription renewals with healthcare providers.
  • Medication synchronization: Work with patients to align their medication refill schedules for greater convenience.
  • Documentation and reporting: Accurately document all patient interactions and outcomes in the Plan's software system.
  • Collaboration: Work with pharmacists and the clinical team to flag complex patient issues for further intervention.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Expertise in Medical/pharmacy terminology, drug nomenclature, basic pharmacology, speaking to members about medication adherence, working with providers and pharmacies to assist in procurement of medications for members, quality initiatives, and pharmacy laws and regulations.
  • Understanding of managed care pharmacy principles and insurance coverage issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate, problem solve, and work effectively with people.
  • Excellent organizational skill with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Work independently and handle multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Knowledge of applicable state, and federal regulations.
  • Ability to take initiative and see tasks to completion.
  • Computer Literate (Microsoft Office Products).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to abide by policies.
  • Ability to maintain attendance to support required quality and quantity of work.
  • Maintain confidentiality and comply with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).
  • Skilled at establishing and maintaining positive and effective work relationships with coworkers, clients, members, providers, and customers.

Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent Completion of the Certified Pharmacy Technician Training Program.
  • Minimum of 0-2 years of experience as a Pharmacy Technician in the ambulatory, community, home infusion, long term care or managed care setting required.
  • Required Licensure/Certification: Active license in good standing as a pharmacy technician with State Board of Pharmacy.
  • Excellent communication skills and interpersonal skills, with a member-centered approach.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting.

GSD Search is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or related medical conditions, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that celebrates diversity and promotes equity for all employees, candidates, clients, and partners.

title: Mailroom Operations Analyst
description:
Job Summary:

The Mailroom Clerk performs a wide range of tasks associated with incoming and outgoing mail including opening, sorting and delivering incoming and intra-office mail; scanning, validating and importing contract and completed documents into various workflow applications; tracking and recording incoming checks associated with new or existing contracts; using mail handling equipment, such as postal meters and sorting equipment to prepare outgoing daily mail, monthly annuity payments and special bulk mailings.

The Mailroom Clerk also maintains records of archived documents for retention, destruction, and is involved with purchasing and storing general office supplies and inventory management.

Main Accountabilities:

  • Identifies, scans and indexes documents for new business workflow including applications and associated paperwork, checks, transfer forms, and miscellaneous documents.
  • Accurately completes and balances check register for incoming checks, scans checks, and delivers checks to treasury department for processing and deposit.
  • Collects documents to be imaged after processing has been completed and indexes scanned documents to correct files for annuity contracts and agent records.
  • Sorts and delivers all incoming mail based on functional areas and prepares outgoing mail and packages for all departments using appropriate mail services (courier, US Government Client, FedEx, UPS, etc.), including but not limited to high priority mail requests, and special mailing projects. Ensures daily pick-up and delivery time schedules are met, and all outgoing mail, including courier or express mail packages, are disbursed by end-of-day.
  • Prepares, processes and disburses outgoing benefit checks to clients.
  • Maintains accurate listing of archived documents and electronic agent and policy files.
  • Maintains archived documents according to company standards for retention and destruction.
  • Maintains inventory on mailing and office supplies (copy paper, envelopes, folders, pens, etc.) and ensures common supply areas are fully stocked.
  • Assists with purchasing and storing general office supplies.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • High school graduate or equivalent required.
  • Associate in Annuity Products and Administration (AAPA) obtained through LOMA is extremely helpful and encouraged.
  • Minimum one year experience in a general office environment, preferably in the insurance/financial services industry, or another regulated industry
  • One year mail/records retention experience preferred and knowledge of basic mail handling procedures and express mailing options.
  • Proficient in use of various software packages including MS Word and Excel, scanning machinery and applications, document storage applications and postal metering equipment.
  • Basic math and computation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with ability to prioritize, multi-task and learn quickly.
  • Must be detail oriented and able to correctly identify proper applications for incoming and outgoing mail.
  • Knowledge of company policies, procedures, and guidelines for contract administration and processing a plus.
  • Must be able to develop and retain a thorough understanding of annuity products and company specific forms and their uses.

title: Mailroom Clerk
description:
Job Summary

The Mailroom Clerk is responsible for managing a variety of mail and document processing tasks to ensure timely and accurate flow of information throughout the organization. This includes opening, sorting, and delivering incoming and internal mail; preparing and processing outgoing mail and shipments; scanning and indexing important documents into digital systems; and maintaining records of checks, archived materials, and office supplies.

The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and enjoys supporting a fast-paced office environment with a focus on accuracy, consistency, and confidentiality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, open, sort, and distribute incoming and interoffice mail and packages.

  • Prepare and process outgoing mail using US Government Client, FedEx, UPS, or other courier services, ensuring daily deadlines are met.

  • Scan, validate, and import documents (applications, contracts, forms, checks, etc.) into digital workflow systems.

  • Accurately record and reconcile incoming checks, preparing them for treasury processing and deposit.

  • Maintain accurate records for archived and electronic files in accordance with retention and destruction standards.

  • Prepare and distribute outgoing benefit or payment checks.

  • Manage supply inventories for mailroom and office materials, ensuring adequate stock and timely replenishment.

  • Assist with ordering and organizing general office supplies.

  • Support special projects and perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • At least one (1) year of experience in a general office or mailroom setting; experience in financial services or another regulated industry preferred.

  • Familiarity with document imaging and indexing systems, scanning equipment, and postal metering tools.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Basic math and computation skills.

  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

  • Understanding of workflow, records retention, or document control processes a plus.

  • LOMA coursework or certifications (such as AAPA) are beneficial but not required.

Equal Opportunity Statement

GSD Search is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Plant Manager
description:
GSD Search has been engaged to identify a Plant Manager in Grand Rapids. The ideal fit will be a resource that has a proven ability to lead a facility across muliple disciplines & departments, people centric and also a leader that is data driven.

Plant Manager - Manufacturing

Job Summary:

We are seeking a results-driven Plant Manager to lead daily operations and drive continuous improvement across all areas of the facility. This role is responsible for overseeing production, process optimization, team leadership, and adherence to operational policies and procedures. The ideal candidate will have a strong focus on safety, quality, and efficiency, with the ability to foster a culture of accountability and growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all plant functions, including production, scheduling, maintenance, and personnel management.
  • Monitor and assess facility performance, identifying areas for operational and financial improvement.
  • Provide leadership, training, and support to management and supervisory teams.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership on budgeting, resource planning, and capital expenditures.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using Lean Manufacturing principles and other industry best practices.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies, quality standards (such as ISO 9001, IATF 16949, ISO 14001), and regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain a safe working environment by enforcing environmental, health, and safety protocols.
  • Promote awareness of customer and quality requirements across the facility.
  • Support Integrated Management System (IMS) implementation and sustainability efforts.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of post-secondary education required; Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.
  • At least 3 years of experience in a leadership role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with injection molding or similar manufacturing processes is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement strategies.
